title: Genetic Polymorphisms in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Diagnosis of pulmonary fibrosis confirmed by physical examination, pulmonary function testing, chest X-ray, and computed tomography (CT) scans.
* Adult patients who are seeking treatment at the Dorothy P. and Richard P. Simmons Center for Interstitial Lung Disease.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 18 years of age
* Non-fibrotic ILD
study_population: Patient population includes patients who have been diagnosed with a fibrotic interstitial lung disease who have been seen by a Simmons Center Physician.
